data.name: Rosilda
data.gender_notes: Rosilda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'rosa' meaning rose, and 'ilda' meaning little or garland. Rosilda is a name rich in the symbolism of the rose, representing love, beauty, and devotion. The name Rosilda carries the meaning “Rose garland, little rose” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Rosilda usually hope their child will grow to embody rose garland, little rose and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's love and devotion towards us
data.etymology: Rosilda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rose garland, little rose.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rosilda total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_greek.name: Ροζίλδη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ροζίλδη έχει τις ρίζες του στη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει η όμορφη και η ευλογημένη, η Ροζίλδη είναι ένα όνομα που χρησιμοποιείται συχνά στην χριστιανική παράδοση και συμβολίζει την γυναίκα που είναι πλήρης ζωής και ομορφιάς

in_latin.name: Rosilda

in_english.name: Rosilda
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rosilda has its roots in the German language, meaning beautiful and blessed woman, Rosilda is a name that is often used in Christian tradition, symbolizing a woman who is full of life and beauty

data.cultural_impact: Named after the beautiful and delicate flower, Rosilda evokes images of grace, elegance, and romance. This name has been popular in various cultures, including Spanish and Portuguese, since the Middle Ages.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian spirituality, the rose holds a special place as a symbol of the Virgin Mary or the Blessed Mother. Roses can represent her purity, love, and grace, as well as the Mysteries of the Rosary and the Five Sorrowful and Five Joyful Mysteries. The name Rosilda is a reminder of the divine and sacred aspects of love and beauty, aligning it with the spiritual ideals of tenderness, compassion, and selflessness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rosilda, meaning "little rose" in Spanish, symbolizes the blossoming of a pure and beautiful Christian soul. Her name is a gentle reminder of the transformative power of faith, as a rose blooms in the presence of love and light.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rosilda is mentioned in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle as a female given name. The name Rosilda carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
